name: Telegram Find Prices
short_desc: Telegram bot that watches channels for product price offers
author: filippolmt
description: Telegram bot that monitors Telegram channels for product price offers and notifies allowed users. It runs a bot and a user account in one background worker, with no web UI. State (SQLite database and bot session) lives in a single data directory.

form_fields.label: Bot token
form_fields.hint: From @BotFather. Use a token that no other instance (e.g. local dev) runs with

form_fields.label: Phone number
form_fields.hint: Phone number of the Telegram user account that reads the channels, international format

form_fields.label: Client session string
form_fields.hint: Telethon StringSession of the user account. See the app description for how to generate it

form_fields.label: Allowed user IDs
form_fields.pattern_error: Comma-separated numeric Telegram user IDs, e.g. 12345678,87654321
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated numeric Telegram user IDs allowed to use the bot

form_fields.label: Username
form_fields.hint: Optional. Telegram username of the user account

form_fields.label: Channel folder
form_fields.hint: Optional. Name of a Telegram folder of the user account whose channels are monitored

form_fields.label: Timezone
form_fields.hint: IANA timezone for the daily summary. Default: UTC

form_fields.label: Daily summary hour
form_fields.hint: Hour (0-23) of the daily summary. Default: 21
